definitions.interactiveMs: Time until the tool page shows the heading Load a sales file and an enabled file input that accepts csv. DuckDB starts later, when a file is chosen.
definitions.fileToBridgeMs: Wall time from just before the file input is set until the bridge table and the KPI row are on screen. Includes DuckDB startup, the CSV read, attribute setup, and the calculation.
definitions.parseMs: From the file mark until the setup panel is on screen and the status text is empty. Includes DuckDB startup and the CSV read.
definitions.configureMs: From parse until Calculate bridge is enabled. The script sets year, jobs, sales, and the four attributes used by the Node bridge.
definitions.calculateMs: From the Calculate bridge click until the bridge table is on screen.
definitions.generateMs: createSyntheticSales on one DuckDB connection, after one discarded warm-up. This is the in-app sample-data path, not a user CSV.
definitions.bridgeMs: runBridge for Design, Coating, Color (photochromic and polar), and Material. Sales, not margin. No gross column.
definitions.dataCheckMs: dataCheck after runBridge. The tool awaits this scan before it draws the bridge. It is not included in bridgeMs.
definitions.identity: Money rounded to 2 decimals and coverage shares rounded to 5 decimals. Raw float sums are not bit-stable.
definitions.gzipBytes: zlib gzip at the default level.
definitions.toolPage: Dist files the local server saw by the time the harness observed the interactive mark. The page sets the mark and the harness polls for it, so a request in that gap is included.
definitions.duckdbOnFirstFile: DuckDB wasm and worker files requested after the interactive mark, during the first file.
definitions.cloudflareBuild: npm run build:cloudflare is a different bundle. It sets VITE_PAGE_COUNTS, VITE_WORKSPACES, and VITE_AI_COMMENTARY, then replaces each wasm file with a gzip copy. This script does not run it.
